source_refs.note: Topic 5.3.1.3 Experiments (PDF 133, printed 130). MCQ 2 is answered (b), matching the key; the control-group and randomization remarks reflect the summary's 'experimental design' and are flagged.

blocks.text: Experiments change one or more variables to find their effect on another, in controlled conditions, which suits science and engineering. A teacher gives one group printed notes and lets another rely only on lectures; after a month both take the same test and the results are compared to see whether the notes helped.
